question: Identify the top 10 and bottom 10 interest categories based on their highest composition values across all months. For each category, display the time(MM-YYYY), interest name, and the composition value
sql:
-- Get top 10 and bottom 10 interest categories with their names - all 20 rows
WITH max_comps AS (
  SELECT 
    interest_id,
    MAX(composition) as max_composition
  FROM interest_metrics
  GROUP BY interest_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    im.interest_id,
    im.month_year,
    im.composition,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY im.composition DESC) as rank_desc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY im.composition ASC) as rank_asc
  FROM interest_metrics im
  JOIN max_comps mc ON im.interest_id = mc.interest_id AND im.composition = mc.max_composition
)
SELECT 
  r.month_year,
  im2.interest_name,
  r.composition,
  r.rank_desc,
  r.rank_asc
FROM ranked r
JOIN interest_map im2 ON CAST(r.interest_id AS INTEGER) = im2.id
WHERE r.rank_desc <= 10 OR r.rank_asc <= 10
ORDER BY r.composition DESC
